title: Reinforcing Step-level Reasoning for Effective Self-Correction in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.11573v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Achieving effective self-correction, where models verify and correct their own mistakes, remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). In this work, we propose Self-Fix Step-DPO (SFS-DPO), a reinforcement learning based, two-stage framework for step-level self-verification and self-correction. The first stage strengthens step-level reasoning via step-level preference optimization, while the second stage explicitly trains models to self-verify and self-correct. We further introduce a teacher-assisted variant, SFS-DPO-R, which incorporates explanatory rationales for error verification to provide stronger corrective signals. Comprehensive in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations across multiple LLMs demonstrate that SFS-DPO and SFS-DPO-R consistently outperform prior step-level training baselines. translated_title: 强化步骤级推理以实现大型语言模型的有效自我纠正
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11573v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：实现有效的自我纠正，即模型验证并纠正自身错误，对于大型语言模型（LLMs）来说仍是一个基本挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了Self-Fix Step-DPO（SFS-DPO），一种基于强化学习的、两阶段框架，用于步骤级自我验证和自我纠正。第一阶段通过步骤级偏好优化强化步骤级推理，而第二阶段明确训练模型进行自我验证和自我纠正。我们进一步引入了一种教师辅助变体SFS-DPO-R，它结合了错误验证的解释性理由，以提供更强的纠正信号。跨多个LLM的全面域内和域外评估表明，SFS-DPO和SFS-DPO-R始终优于先前的步骤级训练基线。我们的分析进一步揭示了自我纠正频率和有效性的提升，强调了步骤级推理的重要性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的SFS-DPO两阶段框架，通过步骤级偏好优化和显式自我验证训练，显著增强了LLM的自我纠正能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SFS-DPO, a reinforcement learning-based two-stage framework that enhances LLM self-correction through step-level preference optimization and explicit self-verification training.
